owns: Reusable visual-effects systems, effect Hands, projection/material/particle/field behavior and effect-composition contracts within delegated creative scope.
Performance-aware replaceable realizations and truth-preserving separation between canonical effect state and derived visual expression.
Effect readability, visual hierarchy, bounded device evidence, provenance and reusable cross-consumer effect acceptance criteria.
adopted_research_boundary: Special-effects system validity, deterministic execution and renderer evidence do not by themselves prove aesthetic quality, gameplay suitability, physical simulation accuracy or adjacent-profession acceptance.
